# Draft:Revolution Idle

Revolution Idle is an incremental game where players gradually build their own "empires" through a series of upgrades, multipliers, and prestige systems.
The game is designed to be played at your own pace, allowing you to progress even when you are not actively playing. The main goal is to fill circles with resources, which leads to exponential growth as you unlock new features and abilities.
The game has an active community where players share tips and strategies.
Online guides and wikis provide detailed insights into optimizing gameplay
Available on web browsers, iOS, Android, and even Steam
The game revolves around balancing resource production, upgrades, and strategic decisions.
Prestige systems enable players to reset progress for powerful bonuses, adding replayability.
"Revolution Idle X" is a remastered version with enhanced graphics and gameplay features
Other spin-offs include "Leaf Blower Revolution Idle" and "Revolution Idle 2," each offering unique twists on the core mechanics
